It must become a 4.5–5-head-tall elongated SD anime game character like IMAGE 2, not a 6–7-head adult fashion illustration, and not a 3-head baby chibi. On a 1536 pixel tall canvas with head-to-feet spanning roughly 1440 pixels, head from scalp crown to chin should be about 300 pixels. Keep visible thighs and shins, an elegant high waist and distinct elbows/knees. Draw a complete new clean coherent painting with those proportions, not a mechanically stretched cutout.
